acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce under parallel load (for example -count=20 with -cpu variations) or document why it cannot be reproduced.
Either fix the race in the test or the code under test, or fold the evidence into V1-0849 and archive this ticket with that reason.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator session from the beamfall/corvint#651 lane (branch claude/gh651, base 79536edd, head 5d1f7167; go1.27.1, darwin arm64).

Suspected, not confirmed: the test failed once with "unassigned stage slot" and passed three times in isolation. A separate `go test ./internal/tasks/dispatch` run failed under host load (429 s against a usual 128 s) with its output not captured, so that failing test is unknown. Related umbrella: V1-0849 (load- and timing-sensitive test failures). Expected: the test passes deterministically or its failure names a real defect.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#748 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/748), merged to main at 5e664ce9cf52f47dbd109eb5c521ee856fbb0579. Reproduced before #734 (3 of 50 runs, attempt_detach_test.go:179 MALFORMED unassigned stage slot) and not after (0 of 200 runs): the V1-0825 race fixed by #734 (CTS-V0-008). heartbeatAfter also retries retryable SNAPSHOT_MOVED. The separate run --attach REDO_PENDING finding was filed and completed as V1-1126. Independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log at the merge commit.
